title: Other Health Insurance Payments Counted on a Joining TRICARE Select Line: Appeals and Grievances Decision Table
content:
**Appeals and Grievances: other-insurer payment counted on the joining line — decision table**

Applies to a further TRICARE Select posting of a claim joining an open Claim Factual Reconsideration on that claim, both carrying the late-filing denial.

The other insurer's payment counted on the joining line is taken as follows: where other health insurance is on file for the patient and the joining line itself shows the other insurer's payment, that payment is counted; where other health insurance is on file, the joining line shows no such payment and an earlier posting of the same service date on the same claim shows one, the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date is counted; in every other case no payment by another insurer is counted.

Records read: whether the patient's active TRICARE Select enrollment shows other health insurance on file; the amount other health insurance paid first as shown on the joining line's own TRICARE Select record (a payment is shown when that amount is above zero); and the same amount on the claim's other postings with the same service date.

| Other health insurance on file | Payment shown on the line | Payment shown on an earlier posting of that service date | Payment counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | the payment shown on the line |
| yes | no | yes | the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date |
| yes | no | no | none (0.00) |
| no | any | any | none (0.00) |

*Hypothetical:* other health insurance on file; the line shows 0.00; two earlier postings of the same service date on the claim show 35.00 and 52.40. The payment counted is 52.40, the largest shown.
